title: POST /capture, the answer
description: What became of this write and nothing else: a capture token reads nothing, so no words, project or other memory is named. A refusal has the door's body instead (contracts/README.md 1.4).

status.description: Always a draft: a capture is never canonical before a person reviews it.

scopes.description: off: everyone in the household reads it (D-048).

held.description: It waits for a person's review, and only a person releases it.

unchanged.description: A mirror with nothing new: nothing was written.

replayed.description: The answer to an earlier request with the same key.
